title: Bulwer-Lytton offered the crown of Greece

tellings.quote: >> Look at Edward Bullwward Linton. At one point he was offered the crown of Greece and he declined it.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher who talks about hidden history and a secret Nazi UFO programme, mentions Edward Bulwer-Lytton, a 19th-century British writer who wrote a book called The Coming Race. Jorjani says Bulwer-Lytton was at one point offered the crown of Greece and turned it down. He raises it to show how much standing and influence the writer had.
